constraints: vpAreaName must name an existing 4D View Pro area; an unknown name raises an error.
viewPro must be a valid 4D View Pro object, typically produced by VP Export to object; an invalid object raises an error.
The imported object's contents replace any data already present in the area.

paramObj.formula is an optional callback invoked once the object is loaded and all 4D custom functions have responded; it receives (param1: area name, param2: reserved/empty, param3: the paramObj reference, param4: a status object with a success boolean).

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Imports and displays the 4D View Pro object viewPro into the 4D View Pro area vpAreaName, replacing any existing content.
